semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Dyna Filters specializes in cleanroom solutions essential for semiconductor fabrication environments.
summary: Dyna Filters Private Limited provides comprehensive cleanroom solutions, including air filtration systems and cleanroom construction services, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing. With over 450 executed projects, they offer a range of cleanroom equipment and panels tailored for various cleanliness standards.
capabilities: Production of cleanroom panels and equipment
Design and engineering of cleanroom systems

regional_presence.South Korea: Dyna has entered into an alliance with Shinsung E&G Co. Ltd., a South Korean company, enhancing their capabilities in large turnkey cleanroom projects.
